methods.laplacian_variance: Variance of 4-neighbor discrete Laplacian; reflected boundary; gray in [0,1].
methods.tenengrad: Mean squared Sobel gradient magnitude; each Sobel derivative divided by 8.
methods.gradient_p90: 90th percentile of normalized Sobel gradient magnitude.
methods.gradient_direction_entropy: 8-bin [0,2pi) direction entropy in bits, weighted by nonzero gradient magnitude.
methods.noise_mad: Laplacian MAD / (0.6744897501960817 * sqrt(20)); uncalibrated robust noise proxy.
methods.residual_mad: MAD of gray minus 3x3 reflected median filter / 0.6744897501960817.
methods.high_frequency_ratio: Variance of gray minus sigma=1 reflected Gaussian / gray variance; constant=0.
methods.global_contrast: Population standard deviation of normalized grayscale.
methods.local_contrast: Mean local standard deviation in reflected 9x9 windows.
methods.intensity_range: p99 minus p01 of normalized grayscale.
methods.gray_mean: Mean normalized grayscale; ITU-R BT.601 weights 0.299,0.587,0.114.
methods.gray_std: Population standard deviation of normalized grayscale.
methods.gray_skew: Third standardized central moment; a constant image has skew=0 by explicit convention.
methods.edge_density: Fraction of pixels with normalized Sobel gradient magnitude > 0.05.
methods.edge_direction_change: Mean circular angular change / pi between horizontal/vertical neighboring edge pixels; no pairs=0.
methods.glcm_contrast: 32-bin symmetric GLCM sum(P*(i-j)^2); mean over valid distance1/2, four directions.
methods.glcm_homogeneity: 32-bin symmetric GLCM sum(P/(1+(i-j)^2)); mean over valid offsets; constant=1.
methods.glcm_entropy: 32-bin symmetric GLCM Shannon entropy in bits; mean over valid offsets.
methods.histogram_entropy: 256-bin normalized gray Shannon entropy in bits.
methods.width: Original decoded image width in pixels.
methods.height: Original decoded image height in pixels.
methods.aspect_ratio: Original width divided by original height.
